info.title: BhuSetu
info.description: BhuSetu: Intelligent Land Record Digitization and Validation System for SIH Problem Statement 26018 (Dept of Land Resources, Govt of India)

get.description: Health check endpoint providing DB connectivity and service status.
Health check endpoint providing DB connectivity and service status.

post.description: User login endpoint returning authentication token, role, and profile.

get.description: Returns currently authenticated user profile and permissions.
Lists available RBAC roles and their associated permissions.

post.description:
Bulk document upload endpoint (accepts PDF/PNG/JPG).
Stores immutably with SHA-256 and triggers the full digitization pipeline.

get.description: Lists all digitized land records with filtering.

Returns complete document details including:
- Pages with quality metrics and dimensions
- Extracted fields (as strict objects with confidence breakdowns and bboxes)
- Legal-logic validation results with evidence
- Forensic tampering flags
- Active review tasks
Automatically applies PII masking if user does not possess VIEW_PII permission.

Returns cadastral GIS cross-check report for the document:
matched parcel polygon GeoJSON, deviations, neighbouring parcels, and spatial evidence.
Lists all configured legal validation rules.
Retrieves all validation rule executions and evidence for a document.
Returns genealogical ownership graph, transfer timeline, and chain continuity analysis.
Returns the complete 40-parcel Cadastral GeoJSON layer with ULPINs and survey boundaries.
Cross-validates document survey area against cadastral GIS parcel boundary.

parameters.name: textual_area_sqm

schema.description: Recorded textual area in sq metres
schema.title: Textual Area Sqm

parameters.description: Recorded textual area in sq metres

get.description:
Looks up a cadastral parcel by its 14-digit ULPIN (Bhu-Aadhaar).
Returns GeoJSON polygon geometry, boundary attributes, and linked digitized record status.
Applies PII masking on owner names for unauthorized roles.
Lists cadastral parcels in GeoJSON format, optionally filtered by village.

Exports digitized land records in JSON, CSV, or GeoJSON formats.
Complies with DoLR data sharing protocols: automatically masks PII for unauthorized users.

parameters.name: format

schema.description: Export format: json, csv, or geojson
schema.title: Format

parameters.description: Export format: json, csv, or geojson

get.description:
Returns live Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP) metrics
for monitoring digitization progress, cadastral integration, and legal consistency.

post.description:
Pushes local BhuSetu progress and validation compliance report to the National DILRMP MIS.
Requires Supervisor or Admin privileges.

get.description: Validates revenue administrative hierarchy against the National LRMS Master Directory.
Lists registered external webhook subscriptions.

post.description: Registers a new webhook subscriber with HMAC-SHA256 signature support.
Sends a test webhook event across active subscribers and returns delivery receipts.

get.description: Retrieves all forensic tampering flags detected for a document.
Lists review queue tasks. Supports prioritizing by uncertainty score for active learning.

post.description:
Submits human verification decision, updates fields, active learning alias memory,
and advances Maker-Checker stage:
- Verifier role submits Maker stage (maker_reviewed)
- Supervisor / Admin role certifies and publishes (Checker stage)

get.description:
Exports all human feedback corrections as a fine-tuning dataset formatted
in JSON Lines (JSONL) with OCR inputs and ground truth human corrections.
Retrieves immutable audit event log history for pipeline transparency.

Cryptographically verifies the SHA-256 hash chaining of all audit records.
Returns status, block count, and confirms zero tampering across the audit log.
Provides high-level operational SIH metrics for executive dashboard.
Lists all configurable validation rules with status and editable thresholds.

put.description: Admin endpoint to enable/disable validation rules or tune thresholds with audit trail.
